svg.text: Grounded answers with clause-level citations over a corporate travel policy. Retrieval maths, cost accounting and tenant isolation live in PostgreSQL; the API stays thin.
Ask a question → watch the pipeline stages → read the streamed, cited answer → open a citation's source clause → inspect the run's cost and full provenance.
text/event-stream: stage · token · citations · cost · done · error
thin by design: validate → set tenant GUC → drive the pipeline → serialise events
startup: register config/*.yaml → pin config bundle · api/deps.py: current_principal → (tenant_id, user_id) · db/pool.py: asyncpg pool connecting as rag_app (NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS)
SQL: vector + lexical → RRF → MMR → expand
regex citation check · no LLM call
out_of_scope still retrieves: citing the section that points elsewhere beats a bare “no”.
every billable call → one cost_ledger row
price recorded before any spend · no keys needed
copy forward embeddings of unchanged chunks
Code asks for a role, never a model — switching models is a YAML edit.
GET /api/runs/{id}/provenance → exact prompts, models and YAML of any run.
the database owns retrieval maths, cost accounting and tenant isolation
Read endpoints (/api/runs, /api/runs/{id}/provenance, /api/costs/summary, /api/documents) query these views directly — no ranking, cost maths or aggregation in Python.
